justification: New Section 12 in the conveyancing PDF, a user-facing legal due-diligence document: a Transport Oriented Development (TOD) catchment disclosure with the mapping instrument named and the capacity engine's conservative as-of-right baseline. Scope decision (2026-07-07): FLOOR ONLY — the uplift ceiling ('up to N dwellings') is deliberately held back from the paid document pending a legal wording review. A dwelling-count claim in a conveyancing report is the highest-liability figure the product renders, so the render gate, three-state failure handling and static guards are the core of this change.

pre_impl.existing_data: Re-verified live 2026-07-07: TOD Sites layer 752 (2,000+ features) and Accelerated Precincts layer 759 (8 precincts) are live and point-queryable via fetch_tod_catchment. Positive lot 67 Warialda St Kogarah (propId 1545912, R4, 904 m², 14.5 m, FSR 1.0) returns in_tod True under SEPP (Housing) 2021; the capacity engine returns floor dwelling_house / 1 dwelling / 904 m² GFA bound by FSR. Bowral and Concord return in_tod False (clean negatives). The plan's documented real-stock reality held up: TOD Sites are dominated by apartment blocks and infrastructure parcels — a non-strata TOD lot is genuinely scarce (67 Warialda is an un-subdivided R4 site being upzoned).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the SEPP TOD layers move or rename, fetch_tod_catchment returns None (both layers failed) and the section is omitted — an opportunity disclosure whose absence is never a false safety claim, so silence is the safe failure. If the capacity engine raises on a known TOD lot, the catchment is still disclosed and the baseline states 'Not assessed', never a fabricated figure. Fixtures are recorded live responses, so an engine field rename shows up as a test-vs-live divergence at regeneration.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused: services.housing_sepp_eligibility.fetch_tod_catchment (live 752/759) and services.constraint_arithmetic.compute_constraint_arithmetic (the gated, never-over-reports capacity engine), via the get_*_live wrapper pattern of get_anef_live/get_bushfire_live, and the parallel-future executor of PR #674/#689. New: a floor-only adapter (calls the engine with ceiling_dev_type=None so the ceiling is never computed) and a pure sentence-builder. NO new capacity or eligibility math; the frontend eligibility engine and its mock station data are untouched.
pre_impl.external_source_error: fetch_tod_catchment None (both layers failed) -> section omitted (opportunity disclosure; absence is safe). Engine exception on a TOD lot -> catchment disclosed + baseline 'Not assessed'. Not in a catchment -> section omitted (a checked negative, asserted absent in tests). No lot area -> engine not run, baseline 'Not assessed'. The block never renders a figure that did not come from the engine result object.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend or API-contract change: the section is a PDF-render addition behind two generate_pdf keyword args (tod, capacity) defaulting to None. The free-tier JSON response, the pipeline cache payload and the Next.js components are untouched; jest and tsc see no new types.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Worst cases for the reader: (a) the held-back ceiling ('up to N dwellings') leaking into the paid document, or (b) a fabricated baseline figure on a failed engine call, or (c) the block rendering for a strata lot a buyer cannot independently redevelop. Each is pinned: the static-claims guard forbids the ceiling engine fields and any 'up to N dwelling' / 'yield of N' pattern in the generator; the baseline figures are all read from the engine result (mutation test: overriding as_of_right_dwellings changes the sentence); the render gate suppresses on strata and on non-TOD; the engine-failure path asserts 'Not assessed' with no metre figure.

functions.name: build_tod_uplift_lines
functions.input: the fetch_tod_catchment result (or None), the capacity-engine ConstraintArithmeticResult (or None), the lot's strata flag, and the lot-area provenance label
functions.output: a pure render plan: render flag, not_assessed flag, catchment disclosure naming the instrument, the as-of-right baseline read from the engine, the held-back line, the input ledger, and the scope line
functions.if_none: capacity None on a TOD lot returns render True with not_assessed True and a 'Not assessed' baseline; a None or non-TOD catchment, or a strata lot, returns render False (silent, no false not-in-TOD claim)

functions.name: get_tod_uplift_live
functions.input: lat, lng, the pipeline controls dict (height, fsr), the valuation dict (lot area), and optional lot dimensions / DCP controls
functions.output: a tuple of the fetch_tod_catchment result and the FLOOR-ONLY capacity result (engine called with ceiling_dev_type None so the held-back ceiling is never computed)
functions.if_none: an import or catchment-lookup failure returns (None, None) so the section is omitted; not-in-catchment or missing lot area returns (tod, None) so the engine is not run and the baseline states Not assessed

functions.name: _tod_form_label
functions.input: the engine development-form string (e.g. dwelling_house, multi_dwelling_housing) or None
functions.output: a plain-English label for the form used in the baseline sentence, falling back to a de-underscored form name
functions.if_none: a None form returns the neutral phrase 'the mapped residential form' rather than an empty or invented label

values.value: as_of_right_form / as_of_right_dwellings / realistic_gfa_m2 / binding_constraint_label read from the capacity ConstraintArithmeticResult into the baseline sentence
values.nullable: yes — any engine field can be None when inputs were incomplete
values.guard_at: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:2515 (getattr with fall-throughs: dwellings falls back to realistic_dwellings, gfa to lep_envelope_gfa_m2; a missing dwelling count drops the count clause rather than printing a bare number)
values.if_missing: the sentence omits the missing clause; no figure is composed that the engine did not supply

values.value: lot_area_m2 / lep_height_m / lep_fsr and the engine gaps[] rendered into the input ledger
values.nullable: yes — LEP height/FSR are commonly absent
values.guard_at: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:2515 (each ledger row prints 'not available' when the value is None; engine gaps are carried verbatim)
values.if_missing: the ledger names the input as 'not available' — a baseline without its inputs named is the D1 fabricated-figure defect class, so missing inputs are shown, never silently defaulted

values.value: tod.epi_name (the mapping instrument) rendered into the catchment disclosure and held-back line
values.nullable: yes — epi_name can be empty in the layer response
values.guard_at: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:2515 (falls back to 'State Environmental Planning Policy (Housing) 2021', the governing instrument for these layers)
values.if_missing: the disclosure still names the governing SEPP rather than leaving the instrument blank

queries: N/A — no SQL changed; all new data comes from the live SEPP ArcGIS TOD layers and the in-process capacity engine

break_it.scenario: A future change wires the engine's held-back ceiling (max_permitted_dwellings) into the floor-only section
break_it.what_happens: The paid legal document would state an 'up to N dwellings' figure the scope decision deliberately holds back pending legal review
break_it.how: the static-claims guard forbids max_permitted_dwellings / max_permitted_form / ceiling_dwellings and any 'up to N dwelling' or 'yield of N' pattern in the generator source; get_tod_uplift_live calls the engine with ceiling_dev_type=None so the ceiling is never even computed

break_it.scenario: The capacity engine raises on a lot the catchment lookup confirmed is in a TOD area
break_it.what_happens: A naive path would omit the section and the buyer would never learn the lot is in an uplift catchment, or worse render a fabricated baseline
break_it.how: capacity None with in_tod True renders the catchment disclosure and a 'Not assessed' baseline with no metre figure; the mutation test asserts render stays True and no envelope number appears

break_it.scenario: The lot is a single strata unit inside a TOD catchment
break_it.what_happens: Rendering a detached-dwelling baseline for one apartment implies a redevelopment right the unit owner does not hold
break_it.how: build_tod_uplift_lines returns render False when is_strata is True; the section is silently absent, consistent with the brief's strata gate

break_it.scenario: Both SEPP TOD layers (752 and 759) are unavailable at report generation
break_it.what_happens: fetch_tod_catchment returns None; a check phrased as 'not in a TOD catchment' would be a false negative
break_it.how: a None catchment result returns render False and the section is omitted — the block never claims 'not in TOD'; it only ever affirms a catchment it positively found

break_it.scenario: The engine reports missing LEP height or FSR for a TOD lot
break_it.what_happens: A baseline that silently defaulted the missing control would overstate the envelope with no trace
break_it.how: the input ledger prints 'LEP height limit: not available' / 'LEP floor space ratio: not available' and carries the engine's own gaps[] verbatim, so every input that fed (or failed to feed) the baseline is named

break_it.scenario: The as-of-right dwelling count is hard-coded in the builder instead of read from the engine
break_it.what_happens: The baseline would print a fixed number regardless of the actual lot, decoupling the sentence from the computation
break_it.how: the mutation test feeds an engine result with as_of_right_dwellings=5 and asserts the sentence reads '5 dwellings' — a hard-coded 1 would fail

break_it.scenario: A non-TOD lot (Bowral) regresses and picks up a spurious Section 12, shifting Disclosure Notes numbering
break_it.what_happens: Section numbering would drift and a non-TOD lot would carry an irrelevant uplift block
break_it.how: the render gate omits the block for in_tod False; the generated Bowral PDF was read and confirmed to have no Section 12 and Disclosure Notes correctly numbered 12, not 13
break_it.repro: python scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py --address '38 Park Road, Bowral NSW 2576' --output /tmp/b.pdf then read Section headings
